item.title: India's opposition leader marches with thousands against election chief
item.description: Opposition parties and supporters of the so-called "cockroach" youth movement marched towards the country's Supreme Court on Monday, in the latest show of outrage against the recent removal of millions of names from voters lists. Critics say the move is likely to benefit Prime Minister Narendra Modi's ruling party – and are demanding India's election chief step down over what they describe as misconduct. item.title: How significant are Burnham’s remarks on Kremlin interference in Brexit vote?
item.description: Prime minister has reopened the debate over whether Russia did seek to influence the 2016 referendum Andy Burnham unexpectedly reopened an old Brexit debate when he said he had been told after becoming prime minister that Russia had interfered in the 2016 EU referendum. It was a contentious issue in the second half of the previous decade, but one that had largely been forgotten about as the UK finally adjusted to the reality of leaving the EU. Now Burnham’s comments have given the topic a fresh impetus. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: ¿Lula dijo que dará un golpe de Estado si gana Bolsonaro en las elecciones de Brasil?
item.description: En redes sociales, usuarios han publicado videos en portugués asegurando que el presidente y candidato a la reelección, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, habría prometido dar un golpe de Estado si su contrincante de la ultraderecha, Flávio Bolsonaro, es electo como presidente. El video, que utiliza la imagen de un reconocido periodista de ‘CNN Brasil’, es falso y constituye una deepfake: es decir, utiliza la imagen y el espectro de voz del reconocido comunicador, para simular que él daba una información de un presunto golpe de Estado. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
